reporting_requirement.when: After each implemented or materially updated screen, before switching workspace or final handoff.
reporting_requirement.rule:
## Haspataal: required progress reporting

Use this repository's Haspataal MCP connection (haspataal_project in Codex,
haspataal in other agents). At the start of every session, call my_progress and
progress_proposals for the connected implementation. Read returned review feedback.
Read overview and get_guide('connecting-your-coding-agent') for the full backend
workflow; use get_screen_bundle and get_ui_quality_brief before building each screen.

After implementing or materially updating any screen, submit propose_progress
without waiting for the developer to ask. Do this before moving to another
workspace or giving your final handoff. A workspace needs a separate proposal
for every screen with newly implemented, tested rubric items.

Use the current rubric fingerprint and item IDs from get_screen_bundle/my_progress,
the connected implementation_id, the tested commit or identifiable build, and
readable Markdown evidence: changed files, checks run and results, and limitations.
Report only items actually implemented and tested. Partial work is reportable;
leave untested items out and describe missing human review honestly. Never invent
test results, a human review or approval.

The human tester records each workspace's review on the portal. Build the DEV-only
Review code setting (get_ui_quality_brief: dev_build_headers): one app-wide field in
Settings -> This terminal, whose code the shared API client sends as X-Haspataal-Review.
Keep it and the X-Haspataal-* headers behind the DEV build flag (compiled out of release
builds). Never set a code yourself, in tests or scripts. progress_proposals returns the
signed reviews' failures: fix them.

First check accepted claims and progress_proposals: do not resubmit unchanged work
already accepted or awaiting review. Reuse the same request_id and identical payload
when retrying a lost response; use a new request_id for changed evidence or a new build.
Verify the saved proposal with progress_proposals. In your handoff, name the proposal
IDs and say "awaiting human review on /docs -> My progress".

If submission fails, keep the exact payload and request_id in the repository without
credentials, report the blocker, and retry at the next session. Never say progress
was posted until the server confirms it. If no item is ready, explain why; do not
submit empty or invented claims merely to satisfy this rule.

Proposals earn no points. Only the human's authenticated portal review can accept
claims; agents must never approve their own proposals or nominate an implementation.

report_on: Agents must submit propose_progress after each implemented screen; the human reviews these on /docs -> My progress. Only accepted items count. Manual human reporting remains available.

backend_issues.next: my_backend_issues(implementation_id) shows each answer in full and marks them read. Re-test a Fixed report once server_build is at or after its fixed_in; read why a Rejected or Duplicate one was refused.

unclaimed.label: 'Re-route / Refer' on a patient of my queue (also from the consultation's Quick-Action Bar): pick the doctor from GET /opd-queues/doctors (by department, with how many wait; never a typed id), or the department alone, give the reason, POST /opd-queues/{queue_id}/reroute. The patient leaves my queue and goes to the TOP of the new doctor's (the same slip, no new payment). VALIDATION_ERROR (details.field): that doctor sees no OPD queue, is me, or the department has none; QUEUE_ENTRY_CLOSED: refresh.
Human review with newly created data
CLINICAL_LOCKOUT: show error.message verbatim ('Patient ticket has been refunded…') and disable editing.

Examination consent before the examination field: three buttons, none selected — 'Verbal consent obtained (VCO)', 'Patient declined', 'Not examined' (examination_consent). Never pre-select one; Declined and Not examined disable the examination field. Under the Clinic profile (GET /establishment) the note cannot be finalized without it (EXAMINATION_CONSENT_REQUIRED). The printed note and prescription show 'VCO'.

Under the Clinic profile 'Submit consultation' also needs the complaint (or history), the examination findings when VCO was obtained, a diagnosis and the plan (treatment or referral): mark the empty fields from CONSULTATION_INCOMPLETE details.missing and keep the draft.

Re-route (workflow §1.4: the patient was sent to the wrong doctor, or the case is not mine): instead of a diagnosis, pick the doctor from GET /opd-queues/doctors (or the department alone) and give the reason, then POST /opd-queues/{queue_id}/reroute with the queue entry the patient was called from; the patient goes back to Waiting at the TOP of the new doctor's queue with the same slip. Close the consultation screen.

POST /clinical-encounters starts new outpatient_procedures work for a Procedure note with its procedure, not an admission's: offer that choice only while outpatient_procedures is Active (GET /establishment active); the rest of the action stays.

PATCH /clinical-encounters/{encounter_id} starts new outpatient_procedures work for the procedure of an outpatient's Procedure note: offer that choice only while outpatient_procedures is Active (GET /establishment active); the rest of the action stays.
POST /admissions starts new inpatient work: offer it only while inpatient is Active (GET /establishment active).
Human review with newly created data
Inpatient orders require dose, route, frequency (or PRN/STAT) and start time — the MAR is generated from them.
self_administration (inpatients): the patient may take an oral, inhaled or topical non-high-alert medicine themselves (SELF_ADMINISTRATION_INVALID otherwise).
Human review with newly created data

The receiving facility: pick it from the contact list (GET /mlc/contacts, kinds ReferralHospital, TraumaCentre, BloodBank, MlrHospital) or type it when the patient chooses (tick 'at the patient's request').

Transport: Own / Ambulance / Rescue / With our staff. With our staff needs the escort's name and shows 'Acknowledgement pending' until the receiving facility's acknowledgement is recorded (who received the patient and when).
Human review with newly created data
Critical values (has_critical_value) → red, sticky alert; acknowledge them on the critical results screen.
Show each test's is_send_out / partner_name (tell the patient it goes to that laboratory) and due_at; a rejected sample means a new one to take (the doctor is notified).

Imaging order: give the side (laterality) of a limb or paired organ; for an inpatient how they come (transport: Walking, Wheelchair, Trolley, Bed, Portable) and escort (a Doctor for special and interventional procedures). Urgent and STAT run against the emergency turnaround.
Open viewer_url in a separate BrowserWindow when imaging.study.available arrives.

Exists for the service laboratory or outsourced_diagnostics or imaging (work): show it as GET /establishment views.screens says for screen_id lab_orders_results (full; open_work: without its new work, with the banner "No new ... from now on"; records: history and corrections only; setup: only from Facility settings; hidden: in no menu), after login and again on establishment.changed. Never decide it from the profile's category.

POST /lab/requisitions starts new outsourced_diagnostics work for a send-out test (availability SendOut): offer that choice only while outsourced_diagnostics is Active (GET /establishment active); the rest of the action stays.

POST /lab/requisitions starts new laboratory work for an in-house test (availability InHouse): offer that choice only while laboratory is Active (GET /establishment active); the rest of the action stays.
POST /imaging/orders starts new imaging work: offer it only while imaging is Active (GET /establishment active).
Human review with newly created data
GET /critical-results?mine=true&open_only=true (or the worklist with mine=true): sticky red banner until acknowledged; critical_result.updated with change Opened for my patient = alarm.

Acknowledge: action_taken (what was done); only a doctor who may treat (CRITICAL_RESULT_ACKNOWLEDGER_INVALID); final once done. Open the lab report (requisition_id) or the radiology report (imaging_order_id) from it.
Human review with newly created data
A patient who died: open the death record screen ('Record death'); later clinical edits are flagged for review.
'Discharge' needs the signed discharge summary (DISCHARGE_SUMMARY_REQUIRED: open the summary screen) and the general consent of the admission (CONSENT_REQUIRED: open the consents screen).

My patients are the admissions whose primary_doctor_id is mine. A Code Red without a doctor (primary_doctor_id null: a triage nurse pressed it) shows to every doctor under 'Waiting for a doctor' with its 'Record reason and diagnosis' task: recording them makes you its doctor. Never show the person who pressed Code Red as the doctor.

vitals.due for one of my patients: mark its vitals due or overdue (overdue_minutes) and re-read GET /admissions/{admission_id}/flowsheet (is_overdue) when it is open; the server decides due and overdue, and the nurse records them (no recording here).

'Hand over to another doctor' on my patient: the doctor (GET /staff/lookup?license_type=PMDC) and the reason, then POST /admissions/{admission_id}/treating-doctor with an Idempotency-Key; it takes effect at once and the patient leaves my rounds (admission.doctor_changed). 'Take this patient' on a Code Red waiting for a doctor (GET /ipd/treating-doctors?waiting=true) names me. Show who looked after the patient before (GET /admissions/{admission_id}/treating-doctor: changes). TREATING_DOCTOR_ONLY: the patient is another doctor's; ask them, or the Hospital Admin while they are away.

Exists for the service inpatient (work): show it as GET /establishment views.screens says for screen_id doctor_inpatients (full; open_work: without its new work, with the banner "No new ... from now on"; records: history and corrections only; setup: only from Facility settings; hidden: in no menu), after login and again on establishment.changed. Never decide it from the profile's category.
Human review with newly created data
Outcome first (Home, Transferred, LAMA, Absconded, Died): it decides which fields show and which are required (`missing` lists them; mark them red).
Show `suggested` beside each empty field with 'Use suggestion' (never fill it silently); the doctor edits the text.

Transferred: receiving hospital, reason and arrangements for the journey (the referral slip prints them). Died: the death record comes first, certified (DISCHARGE_SUMMARY_DEATH_NOT_CERTIFIED); suggested.outcome is Died once a death is recorded, and no other outcome can then be signed (DISCHARGE_SUMMARY_PATIENT_DIED). No medicines or follow-up.

Autosave the draft with PUT (send row_version as expected_version). 'Sign' shows DISCHARGE_SUMMARY_INCOMPLETE's details.missing; after signing there is no Edit, only 'Add correction' (reason required).

Diagnosis codes come from the ICD picker (screen icd_picker): store the `code`, show `icd_terms` (code + title) wherever codes appear; ICD_CODE_UNKNOWN means a code not in the active list (details.unknown). Offer suggested.icd_terms (the notes' codes) as chips.
Print on A4: print-payload (printer_role document) or the pdf_url; hand one copy to the patient.

Exists for the service inpatient (work): show it as GET /establishment views.screens says for screen_id discharge_summary (full; open_work: without its new work, with the banner "No new ... from now on"; records: history and corrections only; setup: only from Facility settings; hidden: in no menu), after login and again on establishment.changed. Never decide it from the profile's category.
Human review with newly created data

'Record death' on the patient (ward, emergency, OPD, brought dead): POST /patients/{patient_id}/death at once, with the time of death (and, brought dead, when the body arrived). The patient is deceased from then on: reload the open screens on death.recorded; new clinical entries are flagged for review.

Lay the certificate out like the WHO form: Part I lines (a) 'due to' (b) 'due to' (c) 'due to' (d), each with the interval and the ICD code (from the ICD picker); the lowest line filled is the underlying cause (show it). Part II below. Then manner; external cause (only for Accident, IntentionalSelfHarm, Assault, LegalIntervention, War); surgery in the last 4 weeks (pre-fill from suggested.surgery); pregnancy (only when patient.pregnancy_applies); the baby's part (only when patient.infant_applies).
Offer suggested.conditions as chips the doctor puts on a line; never fill a line silently.
Autosave with PUT (row_version as expected_version). 'Certify' shows DEATH_CERTIFICATE_INCOMPLETE's details.missing; afterwards there is no Edit, only 'Add correction' (reason required).
A medico-legal death (death.mlc_number) carries a red MEDICO-LEGAL banner and never offers a clinical autopsy.
Print the certificate on A4 (print-payload or pdf_url) for the family and the union council.
An inpatient death continues with the discharge summary (outcome Died) and the discharge: the bed goes through the usual clearance stages.
Human review with newly created data
Offer 'Open MLC' from the emergency visit whenever the complaint matches a case type (GET /mlc/case-types). An unknown patient gets a trauma profile first (POST /patients/trauma).
Write the history as alleged, in the teller's words, and who told it; the examination may follow later (PATCH).

Not brought by the police: 'Inform police' at once (police-intimation: station from GET /mlc/contacts, how, to whom, their reference). It is recorded once and never changes. Keep police_intimation_overdue cases in red at the top.
Print the intimation for the police station (print-payload, A4) and hand over evidence item by item, each signed for (evidence: seal number, officer, receipt).

Settle the medico-legal report: IssuedHere (number, date; upload the copy as a MedicoLegalReport document), Referred (the designated hospital) or NotRequired (why); then 'Close' (MLC_NOT_READY_TO_CLOSE lists details.missing).
Every screen of this patient shows the MLC number (patient.mlc_numbers).
Human review with newly created data

One row per patient in the ER, in the order of `visits`: not triaged yet first (by arrival), then triage level and arrival (MSDS 18: never first come, first served). Colour the row by `triage_colour`; show minutes in the ER and in the stage.

Badges from `flags`: TriageOverdue, DoctorOverdue (the level's target passed), ObservationTooLong, AdmissionWaitTooLong, ReferralWaitTooLong, MlcNotOpened (red), MedicoLegalUndecided (ask the checklist). Header tiles from `by_level`, `by_stage` and `overdue`.
Refresh on er.visit.updated (priority high: a patient became level 1, sound the chime); missed targets also arrive in the inbox (notification.created, category er_wait).

Register an arrival before any ticket (triage comes first; an unknown patient: POST /patients/trauma, then POST /er/visits). An emergency ticket and a Code Red open the visit by themselves. ER_VISIT_OPEN: open details.er_visit_id instead.
Side panel `GET /er/on-duty`: the ER staff on duty now and the consultants on call with the number to call (MSDS 17 iii).

Exists for the service emergency_department (work): show it as GET /establishment views.screens says for screen_id er_board_doctor (full; open_work: without its new work, with the banner "No new ... from now on"; records: history and corrections only; setup: only from Facility settings; hidden: in no menu), after login and again on establishment.changed. Never decide it from the profile's category.
POST /er/visits starts new emergency_department work: offer it only while emergency_department is Active (GET /establishment active).
Human review with newly created data

Triage form from GET /er/triage-scale: the vital signs, then per level the danger signs as tick boxes (level 1 on top, in its colour). Show the level the ticks and vital signs give as the nurse types; POST sends `signs` (discriminator ids) and the vital signs, and the server decides the suggested level.

A level other than the suggested one: ask for the reason (VALIDATION_ERROR carries details.suggested_level and details.matched). Show the whole triage history with each nurse's stamp; re-triage when the condition changes.

The medico-legal checklist is a required yes / no on every triage, with the case type (GET /mlc/case-types) when yes; then offer 'Open medico-legal case' (POST /mlc/cases with the ticket or admission). After a Code Red: POST /er/visits/{er_visit_id}/medico-legal.

Stage buttons: With doctor, Observation, Waiting for referral (the note says where and why). Waiting for admission and for a bed follow the admission (Admit from the consultation screen; the admissions desk's waitlist).

Departure form (MSDS 20) by disposition: Discharged (condition, follow-up advice), Referred (condition, reason, receiving hospital), LAMA (who signed the statement, or when the absence was noticed), Discharged on request (who signed the statement), Left without being seen (when the absence was noticed; not after a doctor saw the patient). Admitted, Died and Brought dead are recorded by themselves (the admission, POST /patients/{id}/death).
After the departure the visit is read-only (ER_VISIT_DEPARTED). The emergency ticket completes with the note; completing it before the departure: ER_VISIT_OPEN.

Upload PDF, JPEG or PNG (multipart/form-data, at most MAX_UPLOAD_MB): UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE for another type, a PDF as the Photo or a file that is not what it claims; VALIDATION_ERROR for a damaged image, an outside document without its facility or a future date; PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE (details.max_bytes) above the limit.

'Reports brought by the patient' (optional, any number): file (PDF, or a JPEG/PNG scan or photo of the paper), type (LabReport, Imaging, DischargeSummary, Prescription, ReferralLetter, Other), title (the test or report, e.g. 'CBC'), issued by (source_facility, required) and the date on it (document_date) → POST /patients/{patient_id}/documents with is_outside=true. List them labelled 'Outside: <facility>, <date>', apart from this hospital's own results: they are never shown or counted as this hospital's lab or imaging results.

Reports and referral letters the patient brings to the ER are attached here, by the triage nurse too (decisions 47): POST /patients/{patient_id}/documents with is_outside, source_facility and document_date.

Exists for the service emergency_department (work): show it as GET /establishment views.screens says for screen_id er_visit_doctor (full; open_work: without its new work, with the banner "No new ... from now on"; records: history and corrections only; setup: only from Facility settings; hidden: in no menu), after login and again on establishment.changed. Never decide it from the profile's category.
Human review with newly created data

screens.title: Verbal orders to countersign and pharmacy queries

unclaimed.label: GET /medication-safety/worklist?mine=true: VerbalOrderToCountersign (overdue in red after verbal_order_countersign_hours) and QueryOpen. Countersign reads the order back to you first.
Answer: ConfirmedAsWritten, or Changed: stop the queried line (or cancel the prescription) and write the new order FIRST (PRESCRIPTION_QUERY_STATE_INVALID otherwise). The answer carries your stamp.
Human review with newly created data

Worklist first (GET /consent-worklist, `mine` for the caller's patients): the admissions without the general consent, the operations not signed in without their consents (OperationConsent, AnaesthesiaConsent), the signed forms still to scan; `overdue` in red; `consent_id` opens the draft already prepared.

Prepare: the form (GET /consent-forms) and the language the patient understands (only languages the form has; CONSENT_TEXT_MISSING lists details.available). POST /consents with the admission, the operation or the visit fills the patient and what it can (the procedure, the surgeon, the anaesthetist, the need for admission); complete what `missing` lists (the procedure, who performs it, risks, benefits, alternatives; for the general consent the need, the stay and the cost).

Print it (print-payload) and lay out `fields.consent.form_body` in `fields.consent.direction`: rtl (Urdu and the other languages but English) in a Nastaliq or Naskh font, `text` and `pdf_url` are then null. Explain it, read it aloud when the patient cannot read, have it signed or thumb-printed, with the witness.

Record the decision: Sign (signer Patient; or DecisionMaker, with a relationship GET /consent-decision-makers allows for this patient: an adult uses adult_priority, a child minor_priority, else CONSENT_SIGNER_INVALID; the questions and answers; a tick 'the patient explained it back'), or Refuse with the reason (VerbalRefusal: witnessed). In an emergency with nobody to consent: mode EmergencyNote, the note and the second doctor.

The caller is stamped as the professional who explained it: an informed consent needs a registered doctor, anaesthesia a doctor of the anaesthesia team (CONSENT_TAKER_NOT_AUTHORIZED). CONSENT_INCOMPLETE lists details.missing: mark those fields.

Scan the signed paper: upload it as a patient document of type Consent (POST /patients/{patient_id}/documents), then POST /consents/{consent_id}/scan. A decided consent is final: Withdraw it (with the reason) and take a new one. Refresh on consent.updated.

Who signs comes from the consent's who_decides, the server's own rule for this patient: patient_may_sign false (a minor by the hospital's adult_age) offers only a decision maker; offer who_decides.decision_makers in their order and no other relationship; ask for the second doctor of an EmergencyNote when emergency_second_doctor. Never classify the patient or hardcode an age of consent on the terminal.
Human review with newly created data

screens.title: Surgical record: pre-operative and operative notes

unclaimed.label: Pre-operative note: history and examination, provisional diagnosis (ICD picker optional), plan, the side to mark; editable until the sign in.

The consent to the operation (part OperationConsent): POST /consents with form_code OPERATION and the booking_id (prefilled with the procedure and the surgeon), in the patient's language; add the risks, benefits and alternatives, print, explain, sign; the sign in needs it (CONSENT_REQUIRED).

Operative note: the first save fills the team, anaesthesia and diagnosis from the record; every part of the post-operative plan is required (offer a 'Not needed' button). Sign when the operation is over, before the patient leaves recovery (OT_OPERATIVE_NOTE_REQUIRED stops the discharge). Signing sets the ward's vitals interval to the plan's monitoring interval.
Every write answers with the whole surgical record: redraw from it. Show `parts` as a strip of steps (Missing grey, Draft amber, Final green, NotNeeded hidden) and `next_step` as the call to action.
A draft lists what signing still needs (`missing`): mark those fields. OT_RECORD_INCOMPLETE carries details.missing too.
Signed parts are read-only (OT_RECORD_FINAL): offer 'Add a correction' (POST /ot/bookings/{booking_id}/corrections with the part, the text and the reason); corrections print under the part.
OT_PRIVILEGE_REQUIRED: the hospital has not authorized this person for this act (clinical privileges); say so and name who may sign. Refresh on ot.clinical.updated.

Exists for the service surgery (work): show it as GET /establishment views.screens says for screen_id surgical_record_surgeon (full; open_work: without its new work, with the banner "No new ... from now on"; records: history and corrections only; setup: only from Facility settings; hidden: in no menu), after login and again on establishment.changed. Never decide it from the profile's category.
Human review with newly created data

Report a suspected infection (POST /infection-cases): the kind (a surgical site infection gives the operation and the depth), the onset, where it was found, the organism if known, the signs and the criteria met; the infection control team confirms or excludes it.

Wound checks after an operation (POST /ot/bookings/{booking_id}/ssi-checks): on the ward round, at the OPD review or by telephone; 'Signs of infection' needs the note and the suspected depth and opens a case itself.
Human review with newly created data
Open on the schedule: your staff due within 30 days and overdue (red); kind Probation or Annual is decided by the schedule (draft_id: continue the draft).

The form: the criteria of the answer (criteria) rated 1-5 with comments, both Administrative and Performance; the targets; the overall rating; strengths; development needs and, below Satisfactory, the development plan (APPRAISAL_INCOMPLETE lists what is missing). Ad hoc: the reason (an incident, a complaint).
Sign: final; print it for the member of staff, who reads, comments and acknowledges (self or HR).
Human review with newly created data
Human review with newly created data
Human review with newly created data
Pick the patient's Given transfusion consent of this stay (GET /consents?patient_id=, category Transfusion); none: link to the consent screen first (BLOOD_CONSENT_REQUIRED). Never pre-select one.
Component, units (1-20), urgency, the indication. An Emergency request may carry the doctor's note authorising uncross-matched blood: a separate field, empty by default, shown only for Emergency.
Show the units issued against those requested and each transfusion's state; Close when no more blood is needed, Cancel (with why) only before any blood was given (BLOOD_REQUEST_STATE).
Send an Idempotency-Key: a retried request must not order blood twice.

Exists for the service blood_transfusion (work): show it as GET /establishment views.screens says for screen_id blood_request (full; open_work: without its new work, with the banner "No new ... from now on"; records: history and corrections only; setup: only from Facility settings; hidden: in no menu), after login and again on establishment.changed. Never decide it from the profile's category.
POST /blood/requests starts new blood_transfusion work: offer it only while blood_transfusion is Active (GET /establishment active).
Human review with newly created data

High risk: two buttons, none selected. When high risk: pick the conditions (multi-select from the list, its Managed/Referred shown beside each), the counselling note is required, and a Referred condition suggests 'Refer' (POST /referrals, then its referral_id).

Category I and II A (GET /establishment: profile I or IIA; rules_in_force high_risk_pregnancy_nutrition): the nutritional assessment and the advice are required for a high-risk patient (MATERNAL_NUTRITION_REQUIRED); elsewhere they are offered.
Append-only: a later visit gets a new assessment; show the patient's earlier ones (GET /maternity/assessments?patient_id=).
Only while the maternity service is Active (x-capability maternity).

Exists for the service maternity (work): show it as GET /establishment views.screens says for screen_id obstetric_assessment (full; open_work: without its new work, with the banner "No new ... from now on"; records: history and corrections only; setup: only from Facility settings; hidden: in no menu), after login and again on establishment.changed. Never decide it from the profile's category.
POST /maternity/assessments starts new maternity work: offer it only while maternity is Active (GET /establishment active).
Human review with newly created data
Only a doctor with a PMDC registration on their staff record assesses, defers and tells (BLOOD_DONOR_DOCTOR_REQUIRED).
The written consent and the donor's declaration of no payment are separate boxes, never ticked in advance; Accepted needs both and the questionnaire reviewed.

Show the PBTA minimums beside the fields (18 or older; a first-time donor at most 60; Hb 13.0 g/dL men, 12.5 women; 3 or 4 months since the last donation). BLOOD_DONOR_INELIGIBLE names each one not met: offer 'Defer' with the reason instead. BLOOD_DONOR_DEFERRED: show the deferral in force.

Deferred: Temporary with its last day, or Permanent, with the reason; 'Told now' records how this doctor told the donor. The PBTA SOP's deferral lists are guidance to show, never rules the screen applies.
BLOOD_DONOR_REACTIVE_UNRESOLVED: an earlier donation of this donor was repeat-reactive; open it and record the doctor's decision (a deferral) before accepting the donor again.

The Reactive worklist (GET /blood-center/donations?status=Reactive; blood_center.donation.reactive refreshes it): tell each repeat-reactive donor in private, refer them for confirmation, record the deferral and how they were told. Revoke a deferral only when entered in error, with why.
Send an Idempotency-Key with every assessment and deferral.

Exists for the service blood_center (work): show it as GET /establishment views.screens says for screen_id donor_assessment (full; open_work: without its new work, with the banner "No new ... from now on"; records: history and corrections only; setup: only from Facility settings; hidden: in no menu), after login and again on establishment.changed. Never decide it from the profile's category.
POST /blood-center/donations starts new blood_center work: offer it only while blood_center is Active (GET /establishment active).

Left: the record (snapshot: notes with author and time, vitals and dose summaries, operations, documents); right: the checklist grouped by category.

Pre-select each answer from auto_results (Pass → Yes, Fail → No, NA → NA) and show its detail line; the reviewer confirms or changes it. A No, or a changed answer, needs a comment (the field turns red).
Submitting is final (RECORD_REVIEW_ANSWERS_INCOMPLETE lists details.problems by code). Opening a record is logged as a patient-data access: open it only to review it.

Fix the record the usual way (a correction entry on the note; records are never edited), then 'Mark corrected' with a note saying what was fixed.
A badge counts the Open ones (GET ...deficiencies?status=Open); notification category record_deficiency.
